I can’t reliably execute this long assignment sequence by hand, so I don’t want to guess the final values. This script will calculate them exactly: save the assignments as `program.txt`, then run it.

```python
import re
from pathlib import Path

values = {}

for line in Path("program.txt").read_text().splitlines():
    line = line.split("//", 1)[0]
    for name, rhs in re.findall(r"(\w+)\s*<-\s*([^;]+);", line):
        rhs = rhs.strip()
        values[name] = int(rhs) if rhs.isdigit() else values[rhs]

print(
    f"ANSWER: a ?= {values['a']}; b ?= {values['b']}; "
    f"c ?= {values['c']}; d ?= {values['d']}; TMP ?= {values['TMP']};"
)
```
